description: Participated in Factory Acceptance Test inspections for fuel and LPG tank truck fabrication, alongside providing on-site technical support to field and office staff.
responsibilities: Performed Factory Acceptance Test inspections during the production of fuel and LPG tank trucks.
Provided technical assistance to inspectors in the field and office, including troubleshooting laptops, tablets, printers, and Wi-Fi connectivity.
Assisted the team during the transition from paper checklists to a digital inspection application and reported issues encountered during its use.
Prepared daily reports and production recapitulations.
